audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Olaf every row except Level 6 (Olaf,Olaf,Olaf,Olaf,Skill,Olaf,Olaf). The packet chart is Olaf,Olaf,Olaf,Skill,Kassadin,Kassadin,Kassadin and the whys[] underneath already describe Kassadin taking 6, first item and 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five strings claim Null Sphere silences — 'a short silence on you', 'his Q silence can interrupt you mid-combo', 'Q-silences your R', 'silences your R activation', 'Q-silence you the moment you E in'. Riot's current description for Null Sphere reads only 'dealing damage and interrupting channels'; there is no silence flag on the ability and no silence in the text.
audit.why: This reverses the player's decision. If Null Sphere silenced, you would have to bait it before committing; it does not, so Olaf's Q-E-R sequence cannot be stopped by it at all — Ragnarok is not a channel and neither is E. Telling a player to hold their combo for a silence that does not exist loses the only window they get in this lane. Also missing: Riftwalk's real cooldown of 5/3.5/2s, which is what actually makes him uncatchable, and Void Stone reducing magic damage (irrelevant to Olaf, who deals physical and true).
audit.corrected: The silence claims are replaced with the real interaction — Riftwalk blinking out of the axe slow — and Riftwalk's 5/3.5/2s cooldown now appears in phases[5].why, spikes[3].text, whys[6] and content.late. Null Sphere is named as an interrupt-channels-only ability in content.early.
sources: enemyKit Q text and flags (channel: interruptible, no silence flag)

audit.why: Riftwalk is correctly named as the tracked cooldown, though at rank 3 it is a 2s cooldown and effectively untrackable — content.late now says so.
content.late already states the win condition correctly: end it before he scales, a 25-minute even game is a loss.

edits.before: Ragnarok deletes CC — once you press R, nothing he has stops the run-down. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kassadin's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Ragnarok blanks CC, but Riftwalk is a blink, not CC — he leaves your slow and the all-in whiffs. From 6 it is his ultimate, not yours, that decides.

edits.after: Sundered Sky is your spike — force fights inside Riftwalk's 5s window, before Rod of Ages lands.

edits.after: Full-build Kassadin blinks every 2s on Riftwalk and bursts you before flat true damage matters — he scales clean past you.

edits.after: Full-build Kassadin blinks in on a 2s Riftwalk and bursts you down before your true damage ever matters.

edits.before: Kassadin is one of the worst level-1-to-5 champs in the game and you are one of the best, so press it hard. His Q is a magic shield plus a short silence on you, and his passive shield eats AP — but you deal physical and true, so neither blunts your trade. Throw Q to slow, walk up, and land E for guaranteed true damage; pick the axe back up to refund it and keep him perma-slowed off CS. Just respect that his Q silence can interrupt you mid-combo, so eat the trade first or bait it.
edits.after: Kassadin is one of the worst level-1-to-5 champs in the game and you are one of the best, so press it hard. Null Sphere leaves him a magic-damage shield and Void Stone cuts magic damage — but you deal physical and true, so neither blunts your trade. Throw Q to slow, walk up, and land E for guaranteed true damage; pick the axe back up to refund it and keep him perma-slowed off CS. Null Sphere only interrupts channels, so nothing he has stops your combo — walk him down.

edits.before: This is all Kassadin. Once he has Rod of Ages and his R cooldown rolls low, he blinks in, Q-silences your Ragnarok activation, and bursts you before your flat true damage adds up. You cannot catch a champion whose whole kit is repeatable blinks. Your only path is to have already ended it — convert your level 1-6 lead into towers, dives and a gold gap so his scaling never gets to matter. If it goes 25+ minutes even, you lose.
edits.after: This is all Kassadin. Once he has Rod of Ages and Riftwalk sits at its 2s rank-3 cooldown, he blinks in, blinks straight back out of your reach, and bursts you before your flat true damage adds up. You cannot catch a champion whose whole kit is repeatable blinks. Your only path is to have already ended it — convert your level 1-6 lead into towers, dives and a gold gap so his scaling never gets to matter. If it goes 25+ minutes even, you lose.

notes: The recurring error on this page is a silence Kassadin does not have. Null Sphere lost its silence long ago; Riot's live description says only 'interrupting channels', the kit file carries no silence flag, and Olaf's E and R are neither channels. Five strings were built on it and four are corrected here (breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d do not mention the silence, so they were left alone). Worth checking whether other AP-mage pages in this repo inherited the same stale silence text — the phrasing 'Q-silences your R' looks templated. Chart flipped in matched pairs to the packet order.
